_comment: Step 9: every string a user reads, in English (the fallback for every other language). Keys must exist in en; other languages may only use keys that exist here (worker/test/i18n.test.mjs lists missing and extra keys). {name} style placeholders are filled by code. Plural forms: en/fr/hy one+other, ru one+few+many. Never an em or en dash.

digest.quiet: {hello}. Quiet period: nothing important on your topics {since}.
digest.quiet_line: Quiet period: nothing important on your topics {since}.
digest.sample_label: Sample digest: the most important news of the last 24 hours on your topics.

bot.welcome_times: I send you a short digest of the most important news at {times} ({zone}).
bot.welcome_next: Your next digest comes {when}. Tap {button} to change topics, times, language and more.
bot.help_new: Hi! Send /start and I will send you short news digests three times a day.
bot.help_paused: Your digests are paused. Send /start to turn them back on.
bot.help: I send news digests at {times} ({zone}). Your next one comes {when}. Send /settings to change them. I can't answer questions; the digest is all I do.
bot.settings: Choose your topics, language and when your digests arrive. Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
bot.support: Axiom News is free, and it stays free. If you like it, you can leave a voluntary tip in Telegram Stars: it helps keep Axiom running. Nothing is locked, and nothing changes for you whether you tip or not. By tipping you agree to the terms: /terms
bot.tip_description: A voluntary tip that helps keep Axiom News running. Nothing is unlocked: Axiom stays free for everyone.
bot.tip_thanks: Thank you for your tip of {amount} ⭐! It helps keep Axiom running. Your digests stay exactly the same.
bot.tip_bad: This tip amount is not available. Please use the buttons under /support.
bot.paysupport: A problem with a tip? Send /paysupport followed by a short note, for example: /paysupport 500 Stars by mistake. The owner of Axiom reads it and can refund a tip made by mistake. Telegram support cannot help with payments to bots.
bot.paysupport_sent: Thank you, your note was sent to the owner of Axiom. A tip made by mistake is refunded to your Stars balance.
bot.terms: Terms for tips. Axiom News is free. A tip in Telegram Stars is voluntary and unlocks nothing; it does not change your digests or settings. As a rule tips are not refunded, but a tip made by mistake is refunded on request through /paysupport. Telegram support cannot help with payments to bots. We keep only who tipped, the amount, Telegram's payment id and the time.
bot.help_cmd: Everything about Axiom is in Settings: open it and tap Help. You can also send us feedback there.
bot.welcome_setup: Welcome to Axiom News, {name}! I send a short digest of the most important news a few times a day. Tap Set up to choose your topics and times. It takes a minute.
bot.reminder: Hi {name}! Your digests come at {times} ({zone}) on the main topics. Tap Set up to choose your own topics and times.

commands.support: Support Axiom with a voluntary tip

errors.reopen: Please close and reopen the settings from the bot.
errors.reopen_simple: Please close and reopen the settings.
errors.keep_time: Keep at least one digest time.
errors.max_times: You can have up to {max} digest times.
errors.times_hour: Times must be on the hour, between {from} and {to}.
errors.pause_bool: Pause must be on or off.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again in a minute.
errors.owner_only: This is only for the bot's owner.
errors.tip_amount: This tip amount is not available.
errors.topic_short: Type a topic, for example Colombia.
errors.topic_limit: Up to {max} topics of your own. Remove one first.
errors.topic_checks_limit: Up to {max} new topics a day. Try again tomorrow.
errors.topic_main: {name} is already a main topic. Switch it on above.
errors.topic_later: Try again in a few minutes.
errors.topic_reason_nonsense: This does not look like a news topic.
errors.topic_reason_private_person: Topics about private people cannot be added.
errors.topic_reason_no_news: There is too little news about this.
errors.topic_reason_too_broad: This is too broad. Try something more specific.
errors.feedback_limit: Up to {max} messages a day. Try again tomorrow.

app.title: Settings
app.keep_time: Keep at least one digest time
app.max_times: Up to {max} times a day. Remove one first.
app.no_connection: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
app.generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
app.open_in_telegram: These settings open from the Axiom News bot. Send /settings to the bot and tap Open settings.
app.tip_failed: The payment did not go through.
app.tip_unavailable: Tips need a newer version of Telegram.
app.help_what: A short digest of the most important news, sent to you here in Telegram at the times you choose. It is free.
app.help_stories: Every hour we read about 120 news sources. An AI groups the articles into stories, scores how important each one is and writes a short summary. Your digest has the stories that matter most on the topics you follow, and never the same story twice.
app.help_topics: Switch the main topics on or off. Under My topics you can add up to 3 topics of your own, for example a country or a sport. A topic that is off sends you nothing.
app.help_times: Pick up to 5 times a day. They follow your phone's time zone.
app.help_lang: Digests and Settings come in the language you pick.
app.help_pause: Pause stops all digests until you switch it off again. Your settings stay.
app.help_support: Axiom is free. If you like it, you can leave a tip in Telegram Stars. A tip changes nothing else.
app.help_privacy: We store your Telegram id, your first name and your settings. The text of a topic you add is sent to an AI to check it. Nothing is sold or shared.
app.setup_sample: A sample digest of the last 24 hours is on its way to your chat.
